### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**3** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **231** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **166** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **166**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **107** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **171** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0cd594b3c77d7e5ac5be02b4c284c5ad5cd1009c` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `61affcc1321fe52e25e3807fd43db3191718b8fc` — the merge of head `721905602ea3550e529438b94c49c85b1e8ef5ac` into base `0cd594b3c77d7e5ac5be02b4c284c5ad5cd1009c`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 61affcc1321fe52e25e3807fd43db3191718b8fc && git checkout 61affcc1321fe52e25e3807fd43db3191718b8fc
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 0cd594b3c77d7e5ac5be02b4c284c5ad5cd1009c 721905602ea3550e529438b94c49c85b1e8ef5ac && git checkout -B drift-repro 0cd594b3c77d7e5ac5be02b4c284c5ad5cd1009c && git merge --no-ff 721905602ea3550e529438b94c49c85b1e8ef5ac

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0cd594b3c77d7e5ac5be02b4c284c5ad5cd1009c
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `721905602ea3550e529438b94c49c85b1e8ef5ac`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts + packages/spec/src/data/field-lookup-autofill.test.ts

Inputs: card #31964 (body, triage 6745990991, claim 6747359582, os-dev-report 6748278592), PR #31972 (body, file list, net diff against `main` at `0cd594b3`, which is the merge base and the tip of `origin/main` at review time, so the net diff IS the PR diff: 3 files, +74 / -32), the check-runs on `72190560` (56 `success`, 11 `skipped`, 0 failed, none running), the contract-review claim 6748786779 on the PR, record 6744679889 on PR #31956 (should-fix S2, the finding this card files), and on `main`: `collectRecordCurrencyPathErrors` as #31956 left it, `validateCrossReferences` (stack.zod.ts:5368 and :5373), `ObjectSchema.fields` (required) and `ObjectExtensionSchema` in object.zod.ts, `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md:99-106`, `content/docs/references/data/field.mdx:99`, the two changeset precedents `.changeset/30303-fls-key-extension-fields.md` and `.changeset/30383-field-path-rules-extension-fields.md`, AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3, and `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs#reviewFace` on the PR's file list. Code outside the diff was read, never reviewed. The changeset is read for ②. Tier: the PR's committed tree carries `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`, a non-test path of the clause-② suspect surface, so `reviewFace` answers the SCHEMA face and this record stands at the tier that face maps to (see ③, dispatch flag).

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Accept set widened at `defineStack` / `os validate` / `os build`: a `lookupAutofill` pair whose lookup references an object this stack knows ONLY through an `objectExtensions` entry is no longer judged — right.** stack.zod.ts:4444 resolves `field.reference` through `declared.has(...)` first; an extension-only name is not in `declared` (:4404-4408), so `referenced` is `undefined` and the pair is skipped at :4445, exactly as a reference the stack does not mention at all already was on `main`. This is the card's ask word for word and the S2 remedy of record 6744679889 carried over to the sibling collector. Pinned (test.ts:214-220): an owner-declared source (`list_price`) and an unknown source (`anything`) are both accepted; the dev's red reading on `main` is consistent with the code there (the merged map held `warranty_note` alone, so `list_price` was refused).
2. **A reference the stack declares AND extends is still judged against the merged map — right.** `declared` holds it (:4400), `fieldsByObject` carries declared fields plus extension fields (:4407), so an extension-added source resolves, an undeclared source keeps its refusal, and a mismatched extension-added source keeps its refusal. Pinned (test.ts:222-231): `warranty_note` → `notes` and `list_price` → `unit_price` accepted; `price` refused "is not a field of 'crm_product'"; `warranty_note` (text) → `is_taxable` (boolean) refused with the type sentence.
3. **No other accept-set change in the `lookupAutofill` collector — right.** Every refusal, its text, the audit-column exception (`AUDIT_FIELD_DEFS`), the `internal` rule, the target-half lookup and `lookupAutofillTypeMismatch` are byte-identical; the one changed statement is :4444. A lookup field an extension adds to an extension-only object is still iterated as a source of pairs (the outer loop walks `fieldsByObject`, which still holds extension-only names), and its own `reference` is now judged on `declared`, the same rule.
4. **`collectRecordCurrencyPathErrors` unchanged in behaviour — right.** The twelve removed lines (base :4514-4527) and the helper body (:4398-4409) are the same statements in the same order: `isRecord(obj) && isRecord(obj.fields)` guard, `declared.add(obj.name)`, merge-by-name set, then the extension loop with the same guard and merge. The collector's loops (:4552 onward) are untouched; its `declared.has(parentName)` and `declared.has(objectName)` reads are the same reads of the same set. Its pins live in `currency-config-record-mode.test.ts`, which `Test Core` ran green on this head.
5. **No public surface change — right.** `stackObjectFields` is a module-private function; no export added, removed or retyped; no schema, describe text or generated artifact moves (`api-surface/`, `authorable-surface/`, `content/docs/references/**` absent from the diff; `Lint & Repo Gates`, which carries `check:generated`, green on the head).
6. **The `isRecord(obj.fields)` guard cannot drop a declared object — right.** `ObjectSchema.fields` is required (object.zod.ts:3467, no `.optional()`), and `defineStack` parses before `validateCrossReferences` runs, so every object in `config.objects` reaches `declared`. An extension entry carrying only `fieldPatches` (no `fields`) is skipped, as on `main`.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/31964-lookup-autofill-extension-only-reference.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': patch`, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. **All three right.** No key, accepted value or metadata type is added, refused or re-meant: the shape (`lookupAutofill` on a lookup whose `reference` is an object this package only extends) parsed on every spec door before and after; what moves is one cross-check in `defineStack` that refused a contract-valid stack. AGENTS.md step 3: "all else is `none`", and "`none` takes `patch`". The arm is `(widening)`: strictly fewer refusals, nothing newly refused (① 1-3). The two precedents the body cites are the same pattern (an extension-field false refusal lifted; `widening`, `none`, `patch`), in `@objectstack/lint`; the spec corpus carries `widening` + `none` + `patch` too (e.g. `.changeset/30001-platform-locale-table.md`).
- The PR body carries the same two lines at line start; `Check Changeset`, `PR-body guards` and `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` are green on the head. The changeset body's Before / Now / One map paragraphs match the diff (② reads them against ① 1, 2 and 4).
- `Skills-docs: none` — right. `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md:103-104` says the source is "a declared, non-`internal` field of `reference` the target can hold", which is still the contract: the owner declares it; the stack door simply no longer pretends to see the owner's fields. `content/docs/references/data/field.mdx:99` ("`os validate` / `os build` judge the source") is generated from `field.zod.ts`, which does not move.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev deviation (shared helper, currency collector edited):** the claim allowed it "only if both collectors' pins stay green". Judged on the tree: ① 4 (same statements, same order) and `Test Core` green on this head. Accepted.
- **Dev deviation (one merge of `origin/main`):** the merge commit is the head; the net diff against `main` at `0cd594b3` equals the PR diff (3 files), so the merge brought nothing into the reviewed files. Accepted.
- **`Metadata-protocol: measured by the dev, reported`** → `none`: judged right in ②.
- **`dogfood_battery: n/a`:** right, no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.
- **`open_questions: []`, `security_findings: none`, `out_of_scope_findings: []`:** nothing to answer; nothing escalated.
- **Acceptance note (no consumer fixture asserts the refusal):** verified read-only on `main`: `git grep` of the refusal text "is not a field of '" outside `packages/spec` and of `lookupAutofill` in `*.test.ts` outside `packages/spec` return four files (a cube join-key message, a dashboard-write fixture, an FLS-serving test, a protocol derivation count), none of which calls `defineStack` or asserts this collector's refusal.
- **Dispatch flag (not a finding on the diff, named for the seat):** claim 6748786779 says the recogniser "reads the declaration face off the paths (no schema path …)" and the brief ordered `TIER_DEFAULT`. `reviewFace` on this PR's file list answers `schema` (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` is a non-test path of `SUSPECT_TIER_GLOBS`), whose tier is `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, with a `Scope:` line and item ④; a `TIER_DEFAULT` record would read `below-tier` to `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`. This record is written at the tier the tree maps to, which is also the tier that served it.
- PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` on the relay; the PR is open (not draft); no `ui/` path, no governed register path, no ADR.

### ④ Design judgment

**packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts** — against card #31964's ask, record 6744679889 S2 (the ruling-shaped remedy: "keep the names declared in `config.objects` apart from those reached only via `extend`, and skip … when the parent is extension-only"), and its first consumer, `validateCrossReferences` (:5368) as `defineStack` runs it for `os validate` / `os build`.
- The change is the S2 remedy applied to the sibling collector, in one statement (:4444), with the `declared` set lifted into `stackObjectFields` so both collectors read one map and one set. The helper's docblock states the rule the two collectors share (a pointer INTO an object resolves only a `declared` one) and the collector's docblock (:4430-4438) is updated to say what is skipped and why, in the words of the `collectHydratedInlineColumnErrors` stance it already cited. Holds.
- The widening is bounded where the card bounds it: a declared-and-extended reference stays judged on the merged map (① 2, pinned), so no refusal on an object this stack owns is lost.
- **Nit N1 — stack.zod.ts:4444 (design, inside the card's ask).** The skip is by object, so on an extension-only reference a source that THIS stack's own extension adds (a field the stack can see) is unjudged too: `{ target: is_taxable, source: warranty_note }` against an extension-only `crm_product` carrying `warranty_note: text` was refused on `main` (a true refusal) and is accepted now. The card prescribed "skip the reference check when the referenced object is extension-only", the sibling collector was ruled the same way, the pin at test.ts:219 asserts it, and a mismatched value is still refused by the save the pick feeds (the docblock's own fallback), so this is the declared design and not a defect. If the seat ever wants that refusal back, the shape is: on an extension-only reference, judge a source found in the extension's fields and skip only an unresolved one; the owner-wins / extension-wins question for a same-named field would need a ruling first.
- **Nit N2 — helper docblock (:4389-4395).** It says "a check that judges another field's pointer INTO an object resolves only a `declared` one"; the currency collector's roll-up half resolves the CHILD (`fieldsByObject.get(ops.object)`, :4575) without a `declared` test, by design (#31956: the summary's own object is the one tested). The sentence is true of the two pointer checks it describes and unchanged code is outside this review; a later reader of the helper may take it for a rule of the whole map. Wording only.
- **Tried, by reading, and did not break:** an extension adding a lookup WITH `lookupAutofill` to an extension-only object (iterated; its reference judged on `declared`; its target half resolves against the extension's own fields, as on `main`); the same object declared twice in `objects` (merge-by-name, unchanged); an extension whose field re-declares a declared field with another type (extension wins in the merged map, as on `main`; the type pin reads the merged definition); an audit column as source on a declared reference (still exempt); `objectExtensions` absent or empty (`declared` equals the object set; `main`'s behaviour exactly).

**packages/spec/src/data/field-lookup-autofill.test.ts** (implementing: the pins that enforce the skip) — `sourceRefusedAt` gains a `rest` spread so a refusal can be asserted with `objectExtensions` present; its one-finding / code / status / path assertions are unchanged. The two new pins cover the widened case (owner-declared and unknown source accepted) and the kept case (resolve, undeclared refusal, type refusal), which is the ①②-relevant partition. Holds.

Summary: 0 must-fix, 0 should-fix, 2 nits (N1 design note inside the card's ask, N2 wording).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`defineStack` / `os validate` 的 lookupAutofill 交叉检查，不再误拒“只通过 `objectExtensions` 认识的引用对象”上的 source 字段。和 PR #31956 给币种路径检查加的 `declared` 集合同一做法；两个检查共用一个私有 helper `stackObjectFields` 来构建字段表。
- 为什么改：别的包拥有的对象，本 stack 只看得到扩展加的字段，原先拿这一部分去判断 source，会把合法的写法报错（#31956 复核时发现，另开 #31964）。
- 风险与回滚：纯放宽，只去掉一个误拒。本 stack 自己声明并扩展的对象仍按合并后的字段表判断；币种检查的行为不变（helper 里是原样搬过去的语句）。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` 的 `collectLookupAutofillErrors` 和 `stackObjectFields`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/field-lookup-autofill.test.ts`，应全绿。
- 需要你做的：无。本 PR 不属受管面，契约复核已通过，由本席落地。
- 席位意见：建议合。CI 全绿，契约复核 PASS，无应改项，两个小 nit 不阻塞。
